events.title: The game will be released on November 11
events.summary: Thanks for waiting, everyone! The game will officially launch on November 11. Thank you all for your support along the way!Here's what's included in this update:Clothing Update Added 10 brand-new outfits — mix and match however you like.Performance Optimization Optimized how monsters spawn, boosting frame rates by about 10–20 FPS for a smoother experience.Bug Fixes Fixed sudden black screens and display issues across various maps.Thank you all for your encouragement and support!

events.title: The equipment system beta is now live!
events.summary: A brand new equipment system has been added to the game!Now, different characters can mix and match various equipment to create their own unique combat style. Equipment is divided into six quality tiers: Common, Refined, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Mythic. The higher the quality, the more powerful the stats and growth potential.All equipment must be obtained by defeating powerful bosses. events.title: Pet System Update – The Cat Bosses Have Arrived!
events.summary: Many players have asked the burning question: "Dogs are great, but where's my cat??" – Fine, you win. Cats have officially landed in the apocalypse!On the wasteland map, your dog remains that loyal buddy who charges into battle with you. Keep rescuing, keep fighting side by side – they're absolute pros. Cats, on the other hand… Combat ability? Not a chance. events.title: 📢 Update Live | Leaderboards Now Available!
events.summary: Each level and every difficulty now has its own Global Top 100 leaderboard. Compete for the best times, climb the rankings, and prove your skills.Challenge yourself—or go head-to-head with your friends.🔥 Can you make it into the Top 100?

events.title: New Map "Cross-Sea Bridge" is now live!
events.summary: In this brand-new map, you are trapped on a long cross-sea bridge— Behind you, an ever-approaching horde of zombies. Ahead, danger lurks as well.There’s no turning back. Only forward.You must find a way out amid the relentless chase, and carve a path to survival caught between both sides.👉 Can you make it off this bridge alive?

events.title: Pet system is now live!
events.summary: You can find trapped dogs on the wasteland map. Once rescued, they will join your team and fight by your side. At the doghouse in your camp, you can switch to your favorite dog at any time (only those that have been successfully rescued).One person and one dog – you don't have to walk the apocalypse alone.
